_README: PROGRESS PAGE CONTENT — everything shown on the Progress page:
status header, gallery photos, construction roadmap, funding
tracker, and update section labels. This is also the single
source of truth for the funding numbers and roadmap milestones
that the Home page summary widgets pull from — update them here
and both pages update. Update entries themselves live in
FUNDING FIELDS (under tracker): asOf (date figures were last
checked), raised (dollars raised so far), phaseGoal (goal for the
current priority phase), phaseLabel (one line describing it),
totalGoal (full amount needed to open), items (budget line items).
ROADMAP FIELDS (under roadmap.milestones): label (small text above
the title — a date for finished phases, or NOW/NEXT/THEN for
future ones), title, body, status (done | current | upcoming —
only one milestone should be 'current' at a time).

status.title: Construction began in April 2026.
status.lede: The timber frame is up and roofing is in place across the main building. Continued progress depends on securing additional materials, labor, and funding. Every gift takes us a measurable step closer to walled, finished classrooms.
